title: Model-Auditing-Model Deception: Can a Smaller Model Audit a Larger One?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: test smaller-model auditing -> if effective, dramatically reduces audit costs -> enables more frequent safety auditing. Central question for scalable oversight.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing Petri-style adversarial auditing with multiple model pairs at different capability ratios. Setting up the auditing framework and coordinating multi-model interactions is beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple components: auditing framework setup, multiple model pair configurations, human auditor baseline for comparison, capability ratio analysis. Very broad for 30 hours.
